scope: Invocation architecture design, main HTML embedding, v2 navigation and diagram disclosure

architectureReview.review: Independent source review of native call ownership
facts: UI calls the native Host SessionController; eligible automatic input can invoke the System3 consumer.
ctx.jev currently uses Fetch; the shared official TypeSafe SDK adapter is a proposed replacement.
AgentLoop calls ctx.llm; model output can request tools and delegation, which Harness dispatches.
The subagent provider manages external expert startup and result ownership; expert runtimes own their internal execution.
Future local general 9B/27B Lead uses the same model and delegation services; its capabilities remain unverified.
Session events and Host projections return progress and results to the UI.
